item.title: A History of Grantham courthouses
item.description: THE system of lay magistrates, by which small crimes are tried, goes back to 1195, the reign of Richard I. He appointed knights known as Keepers of the Peace to ensure the King’s peace was upheld. item.title: Man banned from owning animals
item.description: In June last year Roxy, a German shepherd, was taken to the vets having been found in Lincoln in a particularly poor state of health.
